snippet.title: Resonance: A Plague Legacy - Release Date Reveal Trailer | XBOX Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Pre-order Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy on XBOX Series X|S today: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/p/9NFW93G1GFXG

Venture into the world of Resonance on August 27: face deadly trials, navigate treacherous paths and uncover what was never meant to be revealed…

Sophia’s journey is about to unfold ✨

Resonance: A Plague Legacy is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass.
